text: Another beautiful spiritual significance of Lord Subrahmanya's six faces is the six energy centers within us.
In the Yogic tradition, Lord Subrahmanya is seen as a symbol of awakened Kundalini energy.
Lord Subrahmanya's six faces are considered symbolic of the spiritual journey where Kundalini energy rises through these six energy centers.
It represents the journey of the dormant energy within us awakening and rising upwards.
